title: Design Tic Tac Toe
summary: Play on an N x N board with O(1) win detection using per-line counters instead of scanning, and a bot whose difficulty is a swappable strategy — random, or a minimax player that provably never loses.
concepts: O(1) win detection with incremental line counters
Undo on the board so minimax can explore without copying it
Separating who moves from how a bot decides
Depth-aware minimax scoring, and alpha-beta pruning
Injecting the input source so a human player is testable
extensions: Generalise to k-in-a-row on an N x N board
Add undo and redo for human players
Add a medium-difficulty bot that makes deliberate mistakes
Persist and resume a game in progress
